name: Mechatronic Systems Engineering Major

requirements.title: Check with an advisor
requirements.text: Prior approval by the director of the school is required if the student plans a term with fewer than 12 course units.

requirements.title: Check with an advisor
requirements.text: MSE students must complete nine units (or three courses) of breadth courses with at least one course in each B-Soc and B-Hum category.

requirements.title: Check with an advisor
requirements.text: At least one course (three units) chosen from the complementary studies electives found at https://www.sfu.ca/mechatronics/current-students/undergraduate-students/undergraduate-program-requirements/pre-approved-compementary-study-electives.html.

sections.title: Mechatronic Systems Engineering Elective Courses

requirements.title: Check with an advisor
requirements.text: Students must also complete four mechatronic systems engineering elective courses selected from a pre-approved MSE electives list that is available at https://www.sfu.ca/mechatronics/current-students/undergraduate-students/undergraduate-program-requirements/technical-studies-electives.html.

sections.note:
With undergraduate curriculum committee chair permission, students may replace one MSE elective with either a directed study or a special project laboratory course.
Special topics courses that have been approved by the undergraduate curriculum committee chair and the director may be counted here.

sections.title: Agriculture Technology (AgriTech) Concentration

requirements.title: Check with an advisor
requirements.text: Students also complete two mechatronic systems engineering elective courses selected from a pre-approved MSE electives list instead of four courses.
